note: Crude-authored overlay for the code-intelligence catalog. It holds facts that no upstream source provides, and choices that keep earlier Crude behavior. internal/catalogimport applies it after the upstream data. Every entry needs a note that says why it exists.

go.note: Earlier Crude root rules: a go.work file takes precedence over a nearer go.mod. Formatter: gofmt reads stdin and writes stdout, the same output as the go/format package Crude used before.

rust.note: Earlier Crude root rules. Linguist also assigns .rs to RenderScript; this entry is Rust only. Formatter: rustfmt, as Crude used before.

python.note: Earlier Crude default server and root rules. Upstream lists other servers; they stay as later candidates. Formatter: black, as Crude used before; --stdin-filename lets it find the project configuration. Blocks end by dedent: VS Code's built-in language configuration sets folding.offSide (microsoft/vscode extensions/python/language-configuration.json at e608ca420ca76f4bfc2cfbff02538d66242e8174, MIT). Indent guides use it for blank lines before a dedent.

javascript.note: Earlier Crude root rules are shared by all script language identities.

jsx.note: Earlier Crude root rules are shared by all script language identities.

typescript.note: Earlier Crude root rules are shared by all script language identities.

tsx.note: Earlier Crude root rules are shared by all script language identities.

c.note: Earlier Crude sent .h files as C. Upstream lists .h under C++.

cpp.note: See the c entry for .h ownership.

c-sharp.note: The LSP language identifier for C# is csharp. Earlier Crude default server and solution-first root rules.

odin.note: Earlier Crude used the workspace folder as the root. Linguist also assigns .odin to a data format; this entry is the Odin language only.

gopls.note: Staticcheck stays off on cold large workspaces. Semantic tokens are enabled because this server returns an empty result by default; explicit user settings win. Server configuration: https://github.com/golang/tools/blob/master/gopls/doc/settings.md#semantictokens. Diagnostic scope: https://github.com/golang/tools/blob/master/gopls/doc/features/diagnostics.md

clangd.note: Earlier Crude launch and thread hint. clangd reports diagnostics for files that the editor opens.

rust-analyzer.note: Earlier Crude launch and thread hints. The settings section is also sent as initialization options, as rust-analyzer documents. Cargo's job limit covers build scripts and checks.

pyright.note: Earlier Crude launch and the open-files diagnostic mode, which bounds analysis work.

basedpyright.note: Same bounded diagnostic mode as pyright.
